description.en: Original hydrothermal-chimney process analog: one irregular continuous mineral-growth tower surrounds a true narrow open conduit. Broad changing growth shoulders/rims are part of the same wall geometry, not sleeves or inserted stones. No plume, water mesh, eruption simulation, exact mineral site or paleoecological coexistence claim. Empty eras/biomes facets remain unspecified.
description.zh: 原创热液烟囱过程类比：连续不规则矿物生长塔包围真实狭窄开口通道，变化的生长肩部和层缘属于同一塔壁几何，非套筒或插石。不导出烟羽水体、不模拟喷发、不指定矿点或古生态共存；空时代/生境facet保持未指定。
